description: Latest-two reconciliation planner (manual, user-confirmed repair for the most recent session only, MergeAndReplace accounts). All candidates below are treadmill_running with no heart rate. Local reference: start 2026-08-26T18:13:10Z, duration 1712 s, distance 2.67 km.

rules.tryFindCanonicalOnly: exactly one candidate AND it isCanonicalLocalCopy(local) => that candidate
tryCreate: exactly 2 candidates with distinct remoteIds, else error 'Exactly two distinct Garmin treadmill activities must exist in the local session window.'
exactly one of them isCanonicalLocalCopy, else error 'The complete locally uploaded Garmin activity could not be identified uniquely.'
partial = the other one; startDelay = partial.start - local.start (s); missingDuration = local.duration - partial.duration (s); distanceDelta = partial.distance - local.distance (km)

late partial iff type treadmill_running AND 45 < startDelay <= 600 AND 45 < missingDuration <= 600 AND |missingDuration - startDelay| <= 120 AND |distanceDelta| <= 0.75, else error 'The second Garmin activity is not a bounded late-start partial copy of the local run.'

plan = keep canonical, delete partial; evidence 'Keep complete activity <keep>; remove late partial activity <delete> (start +<startDelay F0>s, duration -<missingDuration F0>s, distance delta <signed F2>km).'
rules.execution: Before deleting, the partial's original FIT is downloaded and must match the retained original backup of this job (SHA-256 or strict semantic equality). Then delete; record RemoteId = MatchedRemoteId = keep. Idle runner, confirmation text 'RECONCILE LATEST TWO', operationId required.

vectors.name: finds the single canonical activity after an uncertain delete response
keeps the complete local upload and selects only the late partial watch activity

expected.evidence: Keep complete activity complete; remove late partial activity partial (start +135s, duration -135s, distance delta +0.37km).

vectors.name: rejects any window containing more than the exact two authorized activities
rejects deletion when the second activity is not a late partial copy
rejects when start delay and missing duration disagree by more than 120 s
